text:
noah (PM): Quick sawtooth sync — milestone 14 is at risk due to KV-degradation + a spike of customer asks for tenant partitioning. Suggest we adopt a hard cut: MVP = SSO + billing events + lightweight promptstore (single-tenant admin + CSV import/export). Defer tenant routing, per-tenant QoS, and analytics to v1. Goal: guarantee GA latency and give Sales a shipable promise.

tara (Eng): +1 to trim. Quick ques: are webhooks included in MVP or v1? Some customers use webhooks for billing webhooks.

noah (PM): Webhooks are v1. For GA we emit billing events to the pipeline; customer-facing webhook delivery is post-GA.

pranav (Infra): Multi-tenant routing requires changing our KV index layout. That adds ~3-5 days infra + e2e. Tail latency risk is material. Recommend rate-limiter gate for GA. Example gate config: `{"rps_per_key":450,"burst_ms":1000,"fallback_model":"rwd-small"}`.

elsa (Design): UX compromise: surface a "lite tenant switcher" in admin and hide the full onboarding. Low friction and keeps support calls low. I can ship mocks by Thu.

morgan (Support): We need exact customer-facing wording. Sales is asking how we phrase GA limits so customers don't assume multitenant parity. Also need a troubleshooting doc for "why my tenant tokens see rate limits".

noah (PM): Draft customer note plan: GA = single-tenant promptstore + SSO; v1 (multi-tenant + QoS + analytics) targeted 2 sprints after GA. I will include an FAQ and expected v1 date for Sales.

tara (Eng): Acceptance criteria proposal for the trimmed MVP:
- SSO (Okta/Google) active for admin and API keys
- Billing events emitted per request (stable envelope)
- Lightweight promptstore: admin CRUD + CSV import/export only
- Conservative rate-limit gate enabled by default
- Canary healthchecks and rollout policy configured
If infra can ship gate + event spec, Eng will freeze surface and focus on hardening.

pranav (Infra): Can deliver gate + event envelope spec by EOD Wed if we reallocate two infra cycles. Well also add a canary-tier config so Sales can trial with a customer.

morgan (Support): Ill draft the customer-facing note + support troubleshooting doc once we have the event envelope and rate-limit numbers.

notify-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline queued: milestone-14/sawtooth-trim (ci#8133) :rocket:

noah (PM): Ok. If no objections by EOD, Ill update the roadmap, notify Sales and Legal, and file the trimmed acceptance criteria in the milestone doc. :thumbsup:
